newsitem.title: USA: Mirage Resorts increases bank facility.
newsitem.headline: Mirage Resorts increases bank facility.

text.p: Mirage Resorts Inc said Friday it has increased its bank credit facility to $1.75 billion from $1.0 billion.

Under the revised terms of the five-year facility the gaming concern can borrow at a rate of about 5.75 percent, Mirage said in a statement. Mirage can increase the size of the facility to $2.0 billion under certain circumstances.

Funds from the unsecured loan will be used primarily to complete construction on its $1.4 billion Bellagio development on the Las Vegas strip as well as its $500 million Beau Rivage beach resort in Biloxi, Miss.
A syndicate of 32 banks participated in the loan which was arranged by BankAmerica Corp, Mirage said.
